_note: acronym: foreign vocabulary — UDB is an acronym and is spelled UDB everywhere this package OWNS the name. `name` stays lowercase because npm forbids capitals in a package name outright (validate-npm-package-name: "name can no longer contain capital letters"), and `repository.url` follows whatever GitHub is serving.
name: @akaoio/udb
description: The universal data door: one chain grammar over every kind of data — content-addressed statics, sync local kv, live market mirrors, filterable collections with live queries, and a SQLite door with an engine per realm. The door is the law.
_dependencies: acronym: foreign vocabulary — the WASM build is a dependency of the browser ENGINE (src/sqlite/wasm.js), which this package owns since 0.3.0. A host never declares it: npm installs it transitively, and src/sqlite/assets.js declares which files the host's builder must copy so a page can reach them (a page has no module resolution, so a bare specifier cannot work there).
author: mimiza
